title: IntelligenceDossier
description: V3.2 compact dossier, stored at data/leads/<slug>/intelligence_dossier.json. Distinct from V2's schemas/dossier.schema.json (the email-generation dossier) -- this one exists to support personalized outreach, fast reply handling, and a later deeper audit if the prospect engages. Never a full SEO report. Only produced after OPPORTUNITY_IDENTIFIED.

business.description: name, niche, city, state, website -- copied from the prospect record

decision_maker_context.description: role/likely_contact_role from V3.1's contactability pre-check -- NOT a verified email; final contact verification is unchanged, out of scope for V3.2

cost_metrics.description: scripts/intelligence_cost.py output, kept alongside the dossier for traceability
